dataset_name: Thomann Germany public deals — sample snapshot
data_collection_method: Human-supervised extraction from official Thomann public webpages accessible through web retrieval; URLs opened individually; NOT an exhaustive catalogue/API feed.

price_explanation.listing_price_eur: Observed product price on a Thomann listings page at collection, not a live checkout price.
price_explanation.product_page_price_eur: Only filled when product-detail price was explicitly inspected.
price_explanation.reference_price_type: 30_day_low = Thomann 30-Tage-Bestpreis; msrp = Thomann UVP. Do not conflate these.
price_explanation.reference_difference_eur: Arithmetic difference between the listing price and its own labelled reference. Not a verified bundle saving or price-drop history.
price_explanation.deal_eligible_for_live_display: False for all records: refresh or validate current product page before calling a deal live.

warnings: Snapshot not comprehensive and not continuously updated.
Some listing pages and product pages disagreed. These are flagged, not silently overwritten.
No true price history, no inferred time-limited promotion, no false savings against MSRP.
Availability null means unknown, not in stock.
Bundle products were identified by official bundle product listings, but component lists and bundle-vs-component savings were not validated.
All price alerts require a new checked observation after this snapshot; no background service is active.
Product images and compatibility specs intentionally excluded from this pricing-only seed; fetch authorized data separately.
